messages:
alex: playback job finished, but ~1.2% events failed validation for customer acme-corp and fintrust.
priya: ugh, what's failing? :thinking:
alex: the validator flagged missing kms.key_id and also an unexpected top-level 'userId' (camelCase). sample payload from replay: 
alex: ```json
{"event_type":"file.download","kms":{"algorithm":"AES-GCM"},"userId":"u-123"}
```
ben: hmm validator expects kms.key_id as a string and no userId (should be user_id). did the transform pipeline run?
audit-bot: Automated replay completed: 1248 events scanned, 15 failures, see https://replay.internal/runs/1876543210
marta: this looks like the new svc-legacy-proxy is dropping key_id on KMS v2 responses :lock:
priya: can someone run `./tools/audit-validator --fixtures golden_v2 --run replay/1876543210` and paste output?
ben: running now, will paste logs
ben: ```
FAIL: event 1023: schema.kms.key_id: missing
FAIL: event 1045: schema.user_id: type mismatch (expected string, got null)
```
jen: regression? we rolled a mTLS change yesterday to proxy. @sam from eng-infra was on call, can you confirm?
alex: @sam? :eyes:
sam: looking. saw a header change in proxy that maps KMS response header X-KMS-ID -> key_id but the header got dropped when content-type changed to application/msgpack
sam: ok recreatable locally, test case: `curl -H 'Accept: application/msgpack' https://svc-legacy-proxy.internal/kms/...` returns no header
marta: plan: 1) add extra normalization in replay harness to map userId->user_id 2) add golden fixture for msgpack path 3) hotfix proxy header mapping so X-KMS-ID is preserved
priya: add unit test to validator that treats missing kms.key_id as a hard failure so CI fails fast on regressions
alex: agree. assigning tasks: marta -> proxy hotfix, ben -> add fixture & validator test, sam -> infra quick patch/rollback, priya -> PR review + CI watch
ben: will open PRs in a bit. linking the failing sample: https://replay.internal/event/1045
alex: also need customer impact check: which customers hit this? audit-bot shows customers: acme-corp, fintrust
jen: pinging customer-success to prepare a heads-up (no PII leaked in these events)
marta: ETA for hotfix ~2h, will post when deployed
priya: thx all :thumbsup:
alex: leaving thread open for rollforward notes
audit-bot: Incident note appended to run 1876543210
